storage.heading: storage
storage.persistent: The browser keeps kalibre's data until you clear it yourself.
storage.best_effort: The browser may clear kalibre's data if the disk runs low.
storage.unsupported: This browser can't promise to keep kalibre's data, so keep a backup.

backup.problem_permission: The browser needs your go-ahead again before it can write there.
backup.problem_conflict: The folder has a newer copy of “{name}”, saved from another browser on {when}, so it wasn’t written over. Restore that copy, or save this one over it.
backup.restore_warning: this replaces everything kalibre keeps in this browser with that copy. sure?

guest.banner_title: You're trying Kalibre as a guest.
guest.banner_body: Your tests, mistakes, stats and XP are kept in this browser, but not backed up, and the profile can't be locked. Save your progress to keep it as your own profile.
guest.ephemeral_warning: guest session: this browser isn't keeping anything, so nothing is saved when this window closes. to keep what you do, download your profile and load it in a normal window.
